text: 吾十有五而志于学，三十而立，四十而不惑，五十而知天命，六十而耳顺，七十而从心所欲，不逾矩
pinyin: wú shí yòu wǔ ér zhì yú xué, sān shí ér lì, sì shí ér bù huò, wǔ shí ér zhī tiān mìng, liù shí ér ěr shùn, qī shí ér cóng xīn suǒ yù, bù yú jǔ
literal: I · ten · have · five · and · set heart · on · learning, thirty · and · stand firm, forty · and · not · doubt, fifty · and · know · Heaven's decree, sixty · and · ear · attuned, seventy · and · follow · heart · desire, not · overstep · rule
natural: At fifteen I set my heart on learning; at thirty I stood firm; at forty I had no doubts; at fifty I knew Heaven's will; at sixty my ear was attuned; at seventy I followed my heart's desire without overstepping the line

meaning.en: Confucius' summary of his own life stages, from first committing to study to complete ease in conduct; it is the source of the age-names 而立, 不惑, 知天命, 耳顺 and 从心所欲.
meaning.zh: 孔子自述一生各阶段的修养，是“而立”“不惑”“知天命”“耳顺”“从心所欲”等年龄代称的出处。

equivalents: the stages of a lifetime of self-cultivation

examples.zh: 人们常用“吾十有五而志于学，三十而立，四十而不惑，五十而知天命，六十而耳顺，七十而从心所欲，不逾矩”来概括人生各阶段。
examples.en: People often use '吾十有五而志于学，三十而立，四十而不惑，五十而知天命，六十而耳顺，七十而从心所欲，不逾矩' to sum up the stages of life.

examples.zh: 爷爷七十岁了，他七十岁了，真是“吾十有五而志于学，三十而立，四十而不惑，五十而知天命，六十而耳顺，七十而从心所欲，不逾矩”的境界。
examples.en: He is seventy and has reached the state of '吾十有五而志于学，三十而立，四十而不惑，五十而知天命，六十而耳顺，七十而从心所欲，不逾矩'.

story.en: Confucius looks back on his life in the Analects, chapter 'Wei Zheng'; each clause gave later Chinese a polite name for an age (30 而立, 40 不惑, 50 知天命, 60 耳顺, 70 从心).
story.zh: 孔子在《论语·为政》中自述一生；后世以“而立”“不惑”“知天命”“耳顺”“从心”分别代称三十、四十、五十、六十、七十岁。

usage.en: A quotation from the Analects; formal, used to make an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 《论语》引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 鱼，我所欲也，熊掌亦我所欲也
pinyin: yú, wǒ suǒ yù yě, xióng zhǎng yì wǒ suǒ yù yě
literal: fish, I · what · desire · [particle], bear · paw · also · I · what · desire · [particle]
natural: Fish is what I want; bear's paw is also what I want

meaning.en: The opening of Mencius' analogy about being unable to have two good things at once; quoted when you must choose between two desirable options (the full line ends: if I cannot have both, I give up the fish and take the bear's paw).
meaning.zh: 孟子取譬的开头，用来说两样都想要却不能兼得、必须取舍的处境。

equivalents: you can't have your cake and eat it
a hard choice between two good things

examples.zh: 买房还是留学？真是“鱼，我所欲也，熊掌亦我所欲也”，难以取舍。
examples.en: Buy a flat or study abroad? '鱼，我所欲也，熊掌亦我所欲也'. It is hard to choose.

examples.zh: “鱼，我所欲也，熊掌亦我所欲也”，二者不可得兼时，只能舍鱼而取熊掌。
examples.en: '鱼，我所欲也，熊掌亦我所欲也': when you cannot have both, you give up the fish for the bear's paw.

story.en: Mencius uses fish and bear's paw to illustrate that when life and righteousness conflict, a person of virtue will choose righteousness.
story.zh: 孟子以鱼和熊掌作比，引出“舍生而取义”的主张。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 生，亦我所欲也；义，亦我所欲也；二者不可得兼，舍生而取义者也
pinyin: shēng, yì wǒ suǒ yù yě, yì, yì wǒ suǒ yù yě, èr zhě bù kě dé jiān, shě shēng ér qǔ yì zhě yě
literal: life, also · I · what · desire · [particle]; righteousness, also · I · what · desire · [particle]; two · [particle] · not · can · obtain · both, give up · life · and · choose · righteousness · [particle]
natural: I want life, and I also want righteousness; if I cannot have both, I will give up life and choose righteousness

meaning.en: The classic statement that moral principle outranks even survival; quoted in praise of martyrs and people who hold to their principles at great cost.
meaning.zh: 孟子的名言，主张道义高于生命，常用来赞颂为正义牺牲的人。

equivalents: better to die with honour than live in shame

examples.zh: 英雄们用生命诠释了“生，亦我所欲也；义，亦我所欲也；二者不可得兼，舍生而取义者也”。
examples.en: The heroes lived out '生，亦我所欲也；义，亦我所欲也；二者不可得兼，舍生而取义者也' with their lives.

examples.zh: 作文里引用“生，亦我所欲也；义，亦我所欲也；二者不可得兼，舍生而取义者也”，立意显得很高。
examples.en: Quoting '生，亦我所欲也；义，亦我所欲也；二者不可得兼，舍生而取义者也' in an essay gives it a lofty point.

story.en: Mencius argues that there are things people desire more than life, and that a person of virtue will give up life rather than righteousness.
story.zh: 孟子论“所欲有甚于生者”，认为君子宁可舍生也要取义。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 道可道，非常道；名可名，非常名
pinyin: dào kě dào, fēi cháng dào, míng kě míng, fēi cháng míng
literal: way · can · be spoken, not · constant · way; name · can · be named, not · constant · name
natural: The Way that can be spoken is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name

meaning.en: The opening of the Daodejing: the ultimate truth cannot be fully captured in words or names; quoted when discussing the limits of language.
meaning.zh: 《道德经》开篇，说明最根本的“道”无法用言语和名称完全表达，常用来谈语言的局限。

equivalents: the Tao that can be told is not the eternal Tao

examples.zh: 《老子》开篇就说“道可道，非常道；名可名，非常名”。
examples.en: The Laozi opens with '道可道，非常道；名可名，非常名'.

examples.zh: 哲学课上，老师讲起“道可道，非常道；名可名，非常名”的玄妙。
examples.en: In philosophy class the teacher spoke of the mystery of '道可道，非常道；名可名，非常名'.

story.en: The first lines of the Daodejing (Laozi), chapter 1, stating that the true Dao exceeds any description.
story.zh: 《老子》（《道德经》）第一章开头，指出真正的“道”不可言说。

usage.en: Quoted in discussions of philosophy; literary and abstract.
usage.zh: 多用于谈哲学，抽象而书面。

text: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然
pinyin: rén fǎ dì, dì fǎ tiān, tiān fǎ dào, dào fǎ zì rán
literal: man · follows · earth, earth · follows · heaven, heaven · follows · the Way, the Way · follows · what is natural
natural: Man follows the earth, earth follows heaven, heaven follows the Way, and the Way follows its own nature

meaning.en: A chain of models in Daoist thought ending in naturalness; quoted to argue for living in harmony with nature and not forcing things.
meaning.zh: 道家思想中层层效法、归于自然的链条，常用来主张顺应自然、不强求。

examples.zh: 环保宣传语常引用“人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然”。
examples.en: Environmental slogans often quote '人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然'.

examples.zh: 他的养生观就是“人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然”，顺其自然。
examples.en: His view of health is '人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然': go with nature.

story.en: Laozi, chapter 25: a hierarchy of what each thing takes as its model, ending with the Way modelled on its own naturalness.
story.zh: 《老子》第二十五章，以层层效法说明“道”以自然为法。

usage.en: Quoted for living in harmony with nature; literary.
usage.zh: 常用来说明顺应自然，书面语。

text: 上善若水，水善利万物而不争
pinyin: shàng shàn ruò shuǐ, shuǐ shàn lì wàn wù ér bù zhēng
literal: highest · good · is like · water, water · good at · benefit · myriad things · and · not · contend
natural: The highest good is like water: it benefits all things without competing with them

meaning.en: Water as an ideal of character: giving to everyone, asking nothing and never contending; quoted to praise humility and quiet generosity.
meaning.zh: 以水喻最高的品德：滋养万物而不与之相争，常用来赞美谦下、无私的品格。

examples.zh: 他一生低调，真可谓“上善若水，水善利万物而不争”。
examples.en: He lived modestly all his life, truly '上善若水，水善利万物而不争'.

examples.zh: 校训取自“上善若水，水善利万物而不争”。
examples.en: The school motto is taken from '上善若水，水善利万物而不争'.

story.en: Laozi, chapter 8, praises water for nourishing everything and settling in low places that others avoid.
story.zh: 《老子》第八章，称赞水滋养万物而居于众人所不愿处的低位。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 治大国若烹小鲜
pinyin: zhì dà guó ruò pēng xiǎo xiān
literal: govern · big · state · is like · cook · small · fish
natural: Governing a large state is like cooking a small fish

meaning.en: A small fish falls apart if turned too often, so a large country should be governed gently and without constant meddling; quoted in speeches on governance and careful management.
meaning.zh: 烹小鱼不宜频繁翻动，治国也应清静无为、不要折腾，常见于谈治理与管理的演讲。

examples.zh: 领导人在讲话中引用了“治大国若烹小鲜”。
examples.en: The leader quoted '治大国若烹小鲜' in his speech.

examples.zh: 管理一个大公司，也要懂“治大国若烹小鲜”的道理。
examples.en: Running a big company also calls for the wisdom of '治大国若烹小鲜'.

story.en: Laozi, chapter 60: a state, like a small fish, is spoiled by too much poking and turning.
story.zh: 《老子》第六十章，以烹小鱼不可常翻动，比喻治国不可烦扰。

usage.en: Quoted in speeches on governance and management; literary.
usage.zh: 多用于谈治理、管理的讲话，书面语。

text: 北冥有鱼，其名为鲲。鲲之大，不知其几千里也
pinyin: běi míng yǒu yú, qí míng wéi kūn, kūn zhī dà, bù zhī qí jǐ qiān lǐ yě
literal: north · dark sea · has · fish, its · name · is · Kun; Kun · [particle] · size, not · know · its · how many · thousand · li · [particle]
natural: In the Northern Darkness there is a fish named Kun; how many thousand li it measures, no one knows

meaning.en: The first lines of Zhuangzi's fable of the giant Kun that becomes the roc Peng; quoted for boundless scale and grand imagination.
meaning.zh: 《庄子》开篇寓言，巨鱼鲲化为大鹏，常用来形容气魄宏大、想象奇伟。

examples.zh: 《逍遥游》以“北冥有鱼，其名为鲲。鲲之大，不知其几千里也”开篇，想象奇崛。
examples.en: The 'Free and Easy Wandering' opens with '北冥有鱼，其名为鲲。鲲之大，不知其几千里也', a soaring imagination.

examples.zh: 他把这部科幻小说的开头比作“北冥有鱼，其名为鲲。鲲之大，不知其几千里也”。
examples.en: He compared the opening of the sci-fi novel to '北冥有鱼，其名为鲲。鲲之大，不知其几千里也'.

story.en: The opening of 'Free and Easy Wandering', the first chapter of the Zhuangzi: the giant fish Kun transforms into the bird Peng.
story.zh: 《庄子·逍遥游》开篇，说北冥之鲲化而为鹏。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 昔者庄周梦为胡蝶，栩栩然胡蝶也
pinyin: xī zhě zhuāng zhōu mèng wéi hú dié, xǔ xǔ rán hú dié yě
literal: once · Zhuang Zhou · dreamed · became · butterfly, fluttering · -ly · a butterfly · [particle]
natural: Once Zhuang Zhou dreamed he was a butterfly, a fluttering, lively butterfly

meaning.en: The opening of the Butterfly Dream, which blurs the line between dream and waking, self and other; quoted for the uncertainty of reality.
meaning.zh: “庄周梦蝶”的开头，模糊了梦与醒、物与我的界限，常用来表达真假难辨。

examples.zh: 读到“昔者庄周梦为胡蝶，栩栩然胡蝶也”，我常想自己是不是还在梦中。
examples.en: Reading '昔者庄周梦为胡蝶，栩栩然胡蝶也', I often wonder whether I am still dreaming.

examples.zh: 诗人用“昔者庄周梦为胡蝶，栩栩然胡蝶也”的典故写人生如梦。
examples.en: The poet used the allusion '昔者庄周梦为胡蝶，栩栩然胡蝶也' to write of life as a dream.

story.en: The Butterfly Dream at the end of 'Discussion on Making All Things Equal': Zhuangzi cannot tell whether he dreamed he was a butterfly or the butterfly now dreams he is Zhuangzi.
story.zh: 《庄子·齐物论》篇末的“庄周梦蝶”：庄周分不清是自己梦为蝴蝶，还是蝴蝶梦为庄周。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 子非鱼，安知鱼之乐
pinyin: zǐ fēi yú, ān zhī yú zhī lè
literal: you · not · fish, how · know · fish · [particle] · joy
natural: You are not a fish; how do you know the fish are happy?

meaning.en: Hui Shi's retort to Zhuangzi on the bridge; quoted when we cannot truly know another's feelings, or in playful debate over knowing others' minds.
meaning.zh: 惠子对庄子的反问，常用来说明难以真正体会他人的感受，或作辩论中的戏谑反问。

equivalents: how can you know what another feels?

examples.zh: “子非鱼，安知鱼之乐”，你怎么知道他不开心？
examples.en: '子非鱼，安知鱼之乐': how do you know he is unhappy?

examples.zh: 辩论赛上，对方一句“子非鱼，安知鱼之乐”，引得全场发笑。
examples.en: In the debate, the other side's '子非鱼，安知鱼之乐' made the whole hall laugh.

story.en: Zhuangzi and Hui Shi stroll by the Hao river; Zhuangzi remarks on the fish's joy, and Hui Shi replies with this line, beginning a famous exchange on knowledge.
story.zh: 庄子与惠子游于濠梁之上，庄子说鱼乐，惠子以此句反问，引出一场关于“知”的著名辩论。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 井蛙不可以语于海者，拘于虚也；夏虫不可以语于冰者，笃于时也
pinyin: jǐng wā bù kě yǐ yù yú hǎi zhě, jū yú xū yě, xià chóng bù kě yǐ yù yú bīng zhě, dǔ yú shí yě
literal: well · frog · cannot · use · speak · of · sea · one, confined · by · its space · [particle]; summer · insect · cannot · use · speak · of · ice · one, bound · by · its season · [particle]
natural: You cannot talk of the sea to a frog in a well, for it is confined to its space; you cannot talk of ice to a summer insect, for it is bound to its season

meaning.en: People are limited by the narrow world they know; quoted to explain why narrow-minded people cannot grasp what lies beyond their experience.
meaning.zh: 人受所处环境和见闻所限，眼界狭窄的人无法理解超出其经验的事物。

equivalents: a frog in a well knows nothing of the sea

examples.zh: “井蛙不可以语于海者，拘于虚也；夏虫不可以语于冰者，笃于时也”，眼界不同，很难沟通。
examples.en: '井蛙不可以语于海者，拘于虚也；夏虫不可以语于冰者，笃于时也': with such different horizons, communication is hard.

examples.zh: 多出去看看吧，别做“井蛙不可以语于海者，拘于虚也；夏虫不可以语于冰者，笃于时也”的人。
examples.en: Get out and see more; don't be someone of '井蛙不可以语于海者，拘于虚也；夏虫不可以语于冰者，笃于时也'.

story.en: The River God, humbled on seeing the sea, is told by the North Sea spirit that limited vantage points restrict understanding; this is the source of 井底之蛙.
story.zh: 河伯见海后自愧，北海若以此说明见识受限于所处的时空，是“井底之蛙”的出处。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 假作真时真亦假，无为有处有还无
pinyin: jiǎ zuò zhēn shí zhēn yì jiǎ, wú wéi yǒu chù yǒu huán wú
literal: false · become · true · when · true · also · false, nothing · become · something · where · something · return · nothing
natural: When the false is taken for true, the true becomes false too; where nothing is taken for something, something reverts to nothing

meaning.en: A couplet on the Land of Illusion in Dream of the Red Chamber: truth and falsehood, being and nothingness, interchange; quoted for the instability of appearances.
meaning.zh: 《红楼梦》太虚幻境的对联，说真假有无相互转化，常用来感叹世事虚实难辨。

examples.zh: 看完这部悬疑剧，我只想起“假作真时真亦假，无为有处有还无”。
examples.en: After this thriller, all I could think of was '假作真时真亦假，无为有处有还无'.

examples.zh: “假作真时真亦假，无为有处有还无”，网络时代真假更难辨。
examples.en: '假作真时真亦假，无为有处有还无': in the internet age truth and falsehood are even harder to tell apart.

story.en: The couplet hung on the archway of the Land of Illusion that Jia Baoyu visits in a dream; it also plays on the name of the Jia (false) and Zhen (true) families.
story.zh: 此联为太虚幻境牌坊对联，亦暗合甄（真）、贾（假）两家之名。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 世事洞明皆学问，人情练达即文章
pinyin: shì shì dòng míng jiē xué wèn, rén qíng liàn dá jí wén zhāng
literal: worldly · affairs · thoroughly · understood · all · learning, human · feelings · well-versed · is · writing
natural: To understand the affairs of the world is learning in itself; to be versed in human feeling is literature in itself

meaning.en: Real-world insight and knowing people count as true scholarship; quoted to say that experience and social wisdom are as valuable as books.
meaning.zh: 洞察世事、通达人情本身就是真学问，常用来说明生活阅历与社会智慧同样可贵。

examples.zh: 老师常说“世事洞明皆学问，人情练达即文章”，要多接触社会。
examples.en: The teacher often says '世事洞明皆学问，人情练达即文章': you must engage with society.

examples.zh: 他不爱读书，却深得“世事洞明皆学问，人情练达即文章”的真谛。
examples.en: He doesn't like reading, yet he grasps the truth of '世事洞明皆学问，人情练达即文章'.

story.en: A couplet seen in Jia Baoyu's dream in the Rongning Mansion, ironically hung in the room where he slept.
story.zh: 此联见于第五回贾宝玉梦前所见的对联，题于宁国府上房。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 满纸荒唐言，一把辛酸泪。都云作者痴，谁解其中味
pinyin: mǎn zhǐ huāng táng yán, yī bǎ xīn suān lèi, dōu yún zuò zhě chī, shéi jiě qí zhōng wèi
literal: full · page · absurd · words, one · handful · bitter · tears; all · say · author · foolish, who · understands · its · inside · flavour
natural: A page full of absurd words, a handful of bitter tears; all call the author foolish, but who understands the taste within?

meaning.en: The poem at the start of Dream of the Red Chamber, about a work that looks fanciful but hides deep sorrow; quoted about writers' pain and misunderstood authors.
meaning.zh: 《红楼梦》开篇诗，说书中看似荒唐，实含辛酸，常用来谈作者的苦心与不被理解。

equivalents: who understands the pain behind the pages?

examples.zh: “满纸荒唐言，一把辛酸泪。都云作者痴，谁解其中味”，这是曹雪芹对自己的写照。
examples.en: '满纸荒唐言，一把辛酸泪。都云作者痴，谁解其中味': this is Cao Xueqin describing himself.

examples.zh: 写作者的孤独，大概就是“满纸荒唐言，一把辛酸泪。都云作者痴，谁解其中味”。
examples.en: The loneliness of writers is perhaps just '满纸荒唐言，一把辛酸泪。都云作者痴，谁解其中味'.

story.en: The verse that closes the opening chapter's preface, in which the author speaks of the long pain and sorrow behind the fictional novel.
story.zh: 第一回开篇所题诗，作者自述全书荒唐之言背后的辛酸。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 滚滚长江东逝水，浪花淘尽英雄
pinyin: gǔn gǔn cháng jiāng dōng shì shuǐ, làng huā táo jìn yīng xióng
literal: rolling · rolling · Yangtze · eastward · passing · water, waves · flower · wash away · all · heroes
natural: The mighty Yangtze rolls east, its waves washing away every hero

meaning.en: History's passing swallows even the greatest heroes; quoted at the start of Romance of the Three Kingdoms and in reflections on time and fame.
meaning.zh: 历史长河淹没一代代英雄，是《三国演义》开卷词，常用来感叹时光流逝与功名易逝。

equivalents: the river of time sweeps away all heroes

examples.zh: 电视剧片头曲唱着“滚滚长江东逝水，浪花淘尽英雄”。
examples.en: The TV drama's theme song sings '滚滚长江东逝水，浪花淘尽英雄'.

examples.zh: 站在江边，不禁想起“滚滚长江东逝水，浪花淘尽英雄”。
examples.en: Standing by the river, I could not help recalling '滚滚长江东逝水，浪花淘尽英雄'.

origin.source: 杨慎《临江仙》（《三国演义》卷首词）

story.en: Ming scholar Yang Shen's lyric (to the tune 'Lin Jiang Xian'); Mao Zonggang placed it at the start of his edition of Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
story.zh: 明代杨慎所作《临江仙》，毛宗岗评本《三国演义》取为卷首词。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 数风流人物，还看今朝
pinyin: shǔ fēng liú rén wù, hái kàn jīn zhāo
literal: count · distinguished · figures, still · look · today · morning
natural: To count the truly heroic figures, look to the present day

meaning.en: The closing line of Mao Zedong's 'Snow': the real heroes belong to the new age; quoted to say that the best talents are of today.
meaning.zh: 毛泽东《沁园春·雪》的结句，意为真正的英雄人物属于当代，常用来鼓励新一代人才辈出。

equivalents: the heroes of today are the greatest

examples.zh: 发奖典礼上，校长以“数风流人物，还看今朝”勉励年轻人。
examples.en: At the awards ceremony the principal used '数风流人物，还看今朝' to encourage the young.

examples.zh: 每个时代都有人高喊“数风流人物，还看今朝”。
examples.en: Every age has people proclaiming '数风流人物，还看今朝'.

story.en: The last line of Mao's 1936 lyric 'Snow', after mocking past emperors for lacking literary or martial genius.
story.zh: 毛泽东1936年词作《沁园春·雪》的结句，前文评点历代帝王之不足。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 江山如此多娇，引无数英雄竞折腰
pinyin: jiāng shān rú cǐ duō jiāo, yǐn wú shù yīng xióng jìng zhé yāo
literal: rivers · mountains · so · very · charming, draw · countless · heroes · compete · bend · waist
natural: So lovely are these rivers and mountains that countless heroes have vied to bow before them

meaning.en: The beauty of the land draws heroes to contend for it; quoted for splendid scenery and for the ambitions it inspires.
meaning.zh: 山河如此壮美，令无数英雄为之倾倒、竞相争夺，常用来赞美壮丽河山。

equivalents: such beauty draws heroes to compete

examples.zh: “江山如此多娇，引无数英雄竞折腰”，这趟旅行让我真切感受到祖国河山的壮美。
examples.en: '江山如此多娇，引无数英雄竞折腰': this trip let me feel the grandeur of our land.

examples.zh: 宣传片结尾配上“江山如此多娇，引无数英雄竞折腰”。
examples.en: The promo video ended with '江山如此多娇，引无数英雄竞折腰'.

story.en: From the first half of Mao's 'Snow', turning from the northern scenery to the heroes of history.
story.zh: 出自毛泽东《沁园春·雪》上阕结尾，由写景转入怀古论英雄。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 恰同学少年，风华正茂；书生意气，挥斥方遒
pinyin: qià tóng xué shào nián, fēng huá zhèng mào, shū shēng yì qì, huī chì fāng qiú
literal: just · fellow students · young, style · brilliance · just · flourishing; scholar's · spirit, vigorous · fervour · full of strength
natural: We were classmates in our youth, brilliant and in full bloom, with a scholar's spirit and a vigour that held nothing back

meaning.en: A portrait of youthful friends full of talent and idealism; quoted at graduations and class reunions.
meaning.zh: 描写青春同窗才华横溢、意气风发，常用于毕业典礼和同学聚会。

equivalents: young, gifted and full of spirit

examples.zh: 毕业纪念册上写着“恰同学少年，风华正茂；书生意气，挥斥方遒”。
examples.en: The graduation yearbook has '恰同学少年，风华正茂；书生意气，挥斥方遒' written in it.

examples.zh: 同学聚会时，大家重温“恰同学少年，风华正茂；书生意气，挥斥方遒”的岁月。
examples.en: At the class reunion we relived days of '恰同学少年，风华正茂；书生意气，挥斥方遒'.

story.en: Mao's lyric 'Changsha' (1925) recalls his student days in the city with his schoolmates.
story.zh: 毛泽东1925年作《沁园春·长沙》，回忆在长沙求学时与同学共度的青春岁月。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 指点江山，激扬文字，粪土当年万户侯
pinyin: zhǐ diǎn jiāng shān, jī yáng wén zì, fèn tǔ dāng nián wàn hù hóu
literal: point out · rivers · mountains, stir up · writing, treat as dung · those years · ten-thousand-household · marquises
natural: We pointed at the land and debated its fate, wrote stirring prose, and scorned the lords of that day as dung

meaning.en: Youthful audacity: discussing affairs of state and writing boldly, holding the powerful in contempt; quoted for spirited, fearless youth.
meaning.zh: 描写青年人评论国是、挥笔著文、藐视权贵的豪情。

equivalents: bold youth who scorn the powerful

examples.zh: 大学时我们也曾“指点江山，激扬文字，粪土当年万户侯”。
examples.en: In college we too once '指点江山，激扬文字，粪土当年万户侯'.

examples.zh: 他年轻时意气风发，“指点江山，激扬文字，粪土当年万户侯”。
examples.en: In his youth he was full of spirit, '指点江山，激扬文字，粪土当年万户侯'.

story.en: From the same lyric about his time at the Changsha First Normal School, where he and his friends discussed national affairs.
story.zh: 同出《沁园春·长沙》，写青年毛泽东与同学纵论国事的豪情。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 问苍茫大地，谁主沉浮
pinyin: wèn cāng máng dà dì, shéi zhǔ chén fú
literal: ask · vast · great · earth, who · governs · rise and fall
natural: I ask the boundless earth: who governs its rise and fall?

meaning.en: A rhetorical question about who will determine the nation's destiny; quoted in speeches about ambition and responsibility.
meaning.zh: 发问谁能主宰天下兴衰，常用于表达抱负与责任的演讲。

equivalents: who will decide the fate of the land?

examples.zh: 面对时代变局，青年人要思考“问苍茫大地，谁主沉浮”。
examples.en: Facing a changing era, young people must ponder '问苍茫大地，谁主沉浮'.

examples.zh: 毕业致辞结尾，他高声问：“问苍茫大地，谁主沉浮”？
examples.en: He ended his graduation speech with the question '问苍茫大地，谁主沉浮'.

story.en: The final question of the lyric, posed after a vivid autumn scene on the Orange Isle.
story.zh: 《沁园春·长沙》下阕前的发问，承上阕写秋景之后提出。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 鹰击长空，鱼翔浅底，万类霜天竞自由
pinyin: yīng jī cháng kōng, yú xiáng qiǎn dǐ, wàn lèi shuāng tiān jìng zì yóu
literal: eagle · strike · long · sky, fish · glide · shallow · bottom, ten-thousand · kinds · frosty · sky · compete · freedom
natural: Eagles strike the sky, fish glide through the shallows, and all creatures vie for freedom beneath the frosty heavens

meaning.en: A picture of living things moving freely in autumn; quoted for vitality and the love of freedom.
meaning.zh: 描绘秋日万物自在生机勃勃的景象，常用来表达生命活力与对自由的向往。

equivalents: a world teeming with free life

examples.zh: 摄影展的主题是“鹰击长空，鱼翔浅底，万类霜天竞自由”。
examples.en: The theme of the photography exhibition is '鹰击长空，鱼翔浅底，万类霜天竞自由'.

examples.zh: 秋天登高远眺，不禁想起“鹰击长空，鱼翔浅底，万类霜天竞自由”。
examples.en: Gazing far from a hilltop in autumn, I recalled '鹰击长空，鱼翔浅底，万类霜天竞自由'.

story.en: From the autumn scene of the lyric 'Changsha', describing the lively life of the Xiang River landscape.
story.zh: 《沁园春·长沙》上阕写湘江秋景的名句。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 不到长城非好汉，屈指行程二万
pinyin: bù dào cháng chéng fēi hǎo hàn, qū zhǐ xíng chéng èr wàn
literal: not · reach · Great Wall · not · true · man, count on fingers · journey · twenty thousand
natural: One who has not reached the Great Wall is no true man; counting on my fingers, twenty thousand li are behind us

meaning.en: The first line is quoted as a challenge to finish a hard journey or goal, a person is not a hero until they have done it; also a tourist's slogan at the Great Wall.
meaning.zh: 首句常被引为不达目标誓不罢休的豪言，也是长城游的流行口号。

equivalents: you haven't truly arrived until you've gone the distance

examples.zh: 在八达岭长城的石碑上刻着“不到长城非好汉，屈指行程二万”。
examples.en: '不到长城非好汉，屈指行程二万' is carved on a stone tablet at Badaling.

examples.zh: 为了完成马拉松，他对自己说“不到长城非好汉，屈指行程二万”。
examples.en: To finish the marathon, he told himself '不到长城非好汉，屈指行程二万'.

story.en: Written in October 1935 as the Red Army crossed Liupan Mountain at the end of the Long March, after about 20,000 li of marching.
story.zh: 1935年10月红军翻越六盘山、长征将尽时所作，长征行程约二万里。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 暮色苍茫看劲松，乱云飞渡仍从容
pinyin: mù sè cāng máng kàn jìng sōng, luàn yún fēi dù réng cóng róng
literal: dusk · colour · vast · look at · sturdy · pine, chaotic · clouds · fly · cross · still · calm
natural: In the vast dusk I look at the sturdy pine, which stays calm while ragged clouds race past

meaning.en: A pine standing unmoved amid driving clouds symbolises calm under pressure; quoted for composure in crisis.
meaning.zh: 以劲松在乱云中从容不动，比喻面对风浪沉着镇定。

examples.zh: 面对危机，他像“暮色苍茫看劲松，乱云飞渡仍从容”一样镇定。
examples.en: Facing the crisis he was calm, like '暮色苍茫看劲松，乱云飞渡仍从容'.

examples.zh: 演讲赞美医护人员“暮色苍茫看劲松，乱云飞渡仍从容”的精神。
examples.en: The speech praised the medical staff's spirit of '暮色苍茫看劲松，乱云飞渡仍从容'.

origin.source: 毛泽东《七绝·为李进同志题所摄庐山仙人洞照》

story.en: Mao's 1961 quatrain inscribed on a photo of Lushan's Fairy Cave taken by Li Jin (Jiang Qing).
story.zh: 1961年毛泽东为李进（江青）所摄庐山仙人洞照片题诗。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 红军不怕远征难，万水千山只等闲
pinyin: hóng jūn bù pà yuǎn zhēng nán, wàn shuǐ qiān shān zhǐ děng xián
literal: Red · Army · not · fear · distant · expedition · hard, ten-thousand · rivers · thousand · mountains · only · ordinary
natural: The Red Army fears not the hardships of the long march; ten thousand rivers and a thousand mountains are nothing

meaning.en: Celebrates fearless perseverance through hardship; quoted when facing long, hard tasks.
meaning.zh: 赞颂不畏艰险、坚忍不拔的精神，常用来鼓励人们面对长期艰难的任务。

examples.zh: 徒步队伍高唱“红军不怕远征难，万水千山只等闲”。
examples.en: The hiking team sang '红军不怕远征难，万水千山只等闲'.

examples.zh: 科研团队以“红军不怕远征难，万水千山只等闲”的精神攻关。
examples.en: The research team tackled the problem in the spirit of '红军不怕远征难，万水千山只等闲'.

story.en: Mao's 1935 regulated verse 'The Long March', written after the Red Army crossed Liupan Mountain.
story.zh: 毛泽东1935年所作《七律·长征》，赞颂红军二万五千里长征。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 雄关漫道真如铁，而今迈步从头越
pinyin: xióng guān màn dào zhēn rú tiě, ér jīn mài bù cóng tóu yuè
literal: mighty · pass · idle · say · truly · like · iron, now · stride · from · the start · cross
natural: Do not say the mighty pass is truly iron; now we stride across it afresh from the very beginning

meaning.en: Confidence after a setback: obstacles are formidable, but we will start over and surmount them; quoted for fresh starts and renewed determination.
meaning.zh: 面对险阻，不畏艰难，重新迈步、从头开始，常用来表达重整旗鼓的决心。

equivalents: start afresh and conquer the obstacle

examples.zh: 新年致辞说：“雄关漫道真如铁，而今迈步从头越”。
examples.en: The New Year address said: '雄关漫道真如铁，而今迈步从头越'.

examples.zh: 失败后他重新出发，“雄关漫道真如铁，而今迈步从头越”。
examples.en: After failing he set out again, '雄关漫道真如铁，而今迈步从头越'.

story.en: Written in February 1935 after the Red Army captured Loushan Pass in the Long March.
story.zh: 1935年2月红军长征中攻占娄山关后所作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。
